title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00376154487703 (+0.56558% over #7708) by removing helper returns with their paid transfers
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This construction gives **conditional κ ≥ 0.00376154487703** on the sixteen-stage signed P104 caller. The lower bound exceeds the upper endpoint of #7708 by **0.00002115478655 (0.56558%)**. The preceding increment was 0.00001034832006. This contribution gains **2.04 times** as much. The selected #7000 reference at the base is 0.00363005817. [Package](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/tree/06b75fde21f4231a2bd0725542c3ba60a908d83b/research/p104-helper-quotients) · [Selected scientific review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/docs/research/pr-intake-evidence/pr7000-application/PROOF-REVIEW.md)

| Complete 16-stage invoice | PR #7708 | This PR |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Paid jobs | 101,488 | 100,416 |
| Productive jobs | 21,152 | 20,624 |
| Paid rank mass | 271,568 | 268,368 |
| Productive rank mass | 272,896 | 269,696 |
| Charged scalar services | 124,542,464 | 123,312,128 |
| Raw crossing | (0.00374039009047, 0.00374039009048) | (0.00376154487711, 0.00376154487712) |

Per native call, 33 helper returns and 67 paid transfers disappear. For example, give up helper 264 and set its old input to the sum of helper 407 and one quarter of helper 434. Three receivers can then reconstruct their missing payloads. This removes paid ranks two, four and three in exchange for one productive rank nine. Every step has positive paid ranks that sum to the rank of its lost target, giving a strict improvement for each power between zero and one. All 400 main fields and all surviving helpers retain their original input and output operators. [Worked example and proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/06b75fde21f4231a2bd0725542c3ba60a908d83b/research/p104-helper-quotients/PROOF.md) · [33 explicit witnesses](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/06b75fde21f4231a2bd0725542c3ba60a908d83b/research/p104-helper-quotients/QUOTIENTS.json)

## Task and overlap

Task `p104-side-correction`, priority revision 8, based on canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The parent is the graph reconstructed by #7708 at scientific commit `f0e2db5b5b46b139da17d2b32fab6633164443a9`, published head `7017edbe4bc5ed1b6d5b6defedbc7e472d83c65c`. The search started with grouped rerouting on its fixed public interface. After 1,979 neighborhood checks gave no cheaper route, the claim recorded a change of scope to a smaller, fully debited helper interface. #7705 uses the separate chart-595 graph. #7709 determines scalar ranges for the fixed #7704 schedule. The neighboring paid-meeting work creates a helper at chart 118 on #7697. A fresh overlap pass covered the titles and bodies of 1,011 open PRs, with separate checks of active Discussions. [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19710820) · [Parent graph](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7708) · [Source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/06b75fde21f4231a2bd0725542c3ba60a908d83b/research/p104-helper-quotients/SOURCE-PINS.json)

DreamingOfClouds opened [PR #7712](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7712) during this submission. Its independent construction splits three rank-nine targets on the same parent, with 101,488 paid jobs and 21,200 productive jobs. Repricing its three published target splits reproduces its bracket (0.00374276975125, 0.00374276975126). This PR’s lower endpoint exceeds that upper by **0.00001877512577 (0.50164%)**, or 1.81 times the preceding #7708 increment. The new productive-minus-paid margin at the #7712 upper is between 6.57768303377 and 6.57768303378. Both constructions use helper 239 differently. The two gains require a separate composition proof. [Peer split manifest](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5001d95a5c1decfb2b0d64d13c130300797e722a/research/p104-banked-cf6a-splits/data/SPLITS.json)

## Validation

Python 3.12.16 on macOS passed the five registered checks. The forward sweep verifies all 1,468 public output rows with 9,657,314 exact coefficient products. A separate reverse sweep verifies all 1,468 input columns. The local checker expands all 67 receiver relations onto independent entrances in their actual graph. The operator checks cover 2,962 ordered chart pairs, all 104 main ports and 1,664 port-stage contacts. Four representative fault classes include a changed relation coefficient, lost global phase, early sender reuse and an off-grid division. The complete schedule uses 8,995 numerical storage locations per call. All 54 strict and four functional outer inequalities pass. At the parent upper endpoint the new productive-minus-paid margin is between 7.41141029282 and 7.41141029283. [Signed application receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/06b75fde21f4231a2bd0725542c3ba60a908d83b/research/p104-helper-quotients/results/application.json) · [Independent column and relation receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/06b75fde21f4231a2bd0725542c3ba60a908d83b/research/p104-helper-quotients/results/witness.json)

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-helper-quotients
```

The first commit contains the scientific package. Main's onboarding test still reads the #6030 CI guide while the selected record names #7000. The second commit carries the existing #7257 CI prerequisite, with its five file blobs verified against the attributed repair. The package tree is identical in both commits. [Scientific commit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/commit/06b75fde21f4231a2bd0725542c3ba60a908d83b) · [CI prerequisite](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/commit/52e7eb424b9ae9f2e6002eb17e475bce6195d848)

The published head passed GitHub planning, prerequisite replay and all five registered scientific checks on Linux. A Git-free macOS export of the 47 package files and four declared inputs passed all five checks and reproduced graph SHA-256 `16e99893a2c669467ce74f214e8eb5150402f0267aaa8d67aad5d870aa4d5c18`. A separate direct comparison evaluated 9,280,471 coefficient products on the parent and 9,657,314 on the child. It recovered precisely the parent matrix with the 33 removed identity coordinates deleted. A fresh full-history clone verified the published bytes, execution modes and source ancestry. [Hosted scientific replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44335932764/job/134915394662) · [All three hosted jobs](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44335932764)

## Open next questions

Independent scientific review is requested for the role-264 restriction and the first transposed restriction for role 559. Reconstruct both on arbitrary inputs, then check that all surrendered targets have been debited. The result inherits the five #7000 interfaces for native operators, owned erasure, compilation, precision tape and analytic recovery. A materialized full multiplier and finite-size runtime remain open. A further construction could test two simultaneous constraints at one entrance. [Open questions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/06b75fde21f4231a2bd0725542c3ba60a908d83b/research/p104-helper-quotients/README.md#open-next-questions)
